authority: Owner explicitly requested immediate construction and replacement of the current HF default release, 2026-11-11

scope.security_type: A-share ordinary equity, including delisted listings

time.bar_coordinates: Preserve each parent byte-for-byte; derive trading dates in Asia/Shanghai and join calendar_session_id. Parent midnight/session coordinates and unknown reference clocks remain disclosed.
time.knowledge: Preserve actual source knowledge clocks. Retrospective research, without historical-PIT promotion.

reference_merge.ordinary: Use complete Base2.5.1 references after checking Hist is a value-identical subset.
reference_merge.intervals: Keep Base full source intervals and add Hist observations absent by id and knowledge_from; reject conflicting duplicate source identities.
reference_merge.factors: Merge PROVIDER_ADJUST_FACTOR/PROVIDER_NATIVE event keys, require identical overlap values, preserve event/source/knowledge fields, derive effective_to from the next source event.
reference_merge.tradability: Frozen Base2.5.1 reference snapshot; coverage is audited against current selected bars. Existing missing-observation reasons are reference-version facts, not current bar absence or trading authority.

quality_segments.profile: inherited sealed Base2.5.1 governance grade; price observations and reference qualifications reported separately

acceptance.reference_limitations: Retain inherited modern missing-factor, lifecycle/calendar, status and historical-source limitations with exact affected-scope ledgers. No absent state is imputed.

raw_sources: Historical source backups and sealed Base2.5.1 ODS remain the source archives; publication carries parent identities, selected member hashes and recovery references.

budget.scope: Local parent composition and publication; no new collection. Full listing/session DISTINCT audit uses the declared separate audit memory budget.
